Question 22 captures (more tool captures), checked 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-19 with Java 25.0.5 (OpenJDK, Linux x86-64).
Jars: v1.7.4 (tag v1.7.4) and v1.8.0 (tag v1.8.0); the rolling asset has the same sha256 as v1.8.0 (jar-sha256.txt).
<version>/<case>.out is the standard output of one command, <version>/<case>.err its standard error (empty file when
nothing was written), both with only two replacements: the scratch root by <tmp> and the repository by <repo>.
<version>/commands.txt: case | command | exit code; <version>/README.md: the same as a table, with the bytes of each
stream and the files the run left next to the spec; <version>/table.tsv: the same, machine readable.
<version>/inputs/: the PlusCal-stale modules, generated by run.py with that version's translator.
specs/: the specs and configs new for this question. Cases named q01-* reuse specs/ and commands of research 1
(../01-tlc-output), q12-* the inputs and commands of research 12 (../12-sany-pcal-repl), tool-* mostly the specs of research 15.
run.py: the driver (TLAUP_TMP=<scratch folder with jars/<version>/tla2tools.jar> python3 run.py v1.7.4).
Each case ran in its own fresh copy of the spec folder; -metadir was under the scratch folder.
Timestamps, pids, seeds, fingerprint seeds, the random folder name of the standard modules (/tmp/tlc-<n>) and rates differ
from run to run. Cases that run for a long time: checkpoint-run (stopped by SIGTERM at 80 s), checkpoint-recover
(about 3 minutes), generate-success (1.8.0, stopped by the driver at 120 s, exit 137).
